remarks: Tucked away in the prestigious hills of Hacienda Heights, 2907 Rio Lempa Dr is a rare sanctuary where refined living meets nature. Wake up to golden morning light pouring through the east-facing entry and sweeping views of the lush mountainside right from your own backyard. This beautifully renovated 2,005 sqft residence (4b/4b) sits on an expansive 0.38-acre lot wrapped in mature greenery, offering exceptional privacy and tranquility. The owner spared no expense $350,000 in upgrades: gleaming new flooring, designer bathrooms, and a stunning new kitchen.
